A pharmacometrics analysis can go wrong at the question, its causal
assumptions, the sources, the data, the code, the model, the predictions,
the conclusions or the way it is presented. Checklists exist for several of these, among them the
[validation checklist](../../references/Validation_Checklist.pdf) written
with Oliver Sander, the R coding checklist, and the uncertainty checklist.
This project lists every kind of validation an activity needs, maps the
existing tools onto them, and ranks the gaps. The same validation plan is
meant to apply whether the work was done by a coding agent, an intern or a
senior associate. Nothing is settled yet.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). The taxonomy of eleven kinds of
  validation, the tools and gaps for each, a validation plan template, the
  gaps ranked, and the open questions.
- [Validating code written by an AI agent](agent-written-code.qmd). The
  project's first specification, now one entry of the taxonomy: which parts
  of the existing validation checklist still apply when an agent writes all
  the code.
